cases.case_label: AluYb9 insertion with 2.3 kb deletion removing LPL exon 2
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~150 bp 5'-truncated AluYb9 with poly(A) tail was inserted at the junction of a 2.3 kb deletion (intron 1 to intron 2) that removes exon 2; the patient was homozygous, with no LPL activity or mass.
cases.quote: These findings indicated that Alu retrotransposition caused the complex deletion-insertion.
